messages.content:
Classify the following user query into **one** of the intent labels listed below. Respond with **only** the exact label (no punctuation, no surrounding text).

Intents:
Refund_not_showing_up = user says a refund they expected has not arrived.
activate_my_card = user wants to enable a newly received card.
age_limit = user asks about eligibility or age requirements for an account.
apple_pay_or_google_pay = user inquires about using Apple Pay or Google Pay for top‑ups or payments.
atm_support = user asks which ATMs can be used or about ATM availability.
automatic_top_up = user wants to enable or locate the auto‑top‑up feature.
balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer = balance hasn't changed after a bank transfer.
balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash_deposit = balance hasn't changed after depositing cash or a cheque.
beneficiary_not_allowed = transfer to a beneficiary fails because the beneficiary is not allowed.
cancel_transfer = user wants to cancel a transfer they have initiated.
card_about_to_expire = user asks about card expiration, replacement cost and timing.
card_acceptance = user asks where the card can be used (merchant acceptance).
card_arrival = ordered card has not arrived yet.
card_delivery_estimate = user asks how long delivery will take before the card arrives.
card_linking = user wants to link a card to the app.
card_not_working = user reports a general card malfunction (not contactless specific).
card_payment_fee_charged = user sees a fee on a card payment.
card_payment_not_recognised = user does not recognise a card payment.
card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate = user sees a wrong exchange rate on a card purchase.
card_swallowed = ATM has captured or ate the card.
cash_withdrawal_charge = user sees a fee on a cash withdrawal.
cash_withdrawal_not_recognised = user does not recognise a cash withdrawal.
change_pin = user wants to change their PIN.
compromised_card = user suspects fraud or unauthorized use of their card.
contactless_not_working = contactless function specifically not working.
country_support = user asks if the service is available in a particular country.
declined_card_payment = card payment was declined.
declined_cash_withdrawal = cash withdrawal was declined.
declined_transfer = transfer was declined.
direct_debit_payment_not_recognised = user does not recognise a direct‑debit payment.
disposable_card_limits = user asks about limits for disposable virtual cards.
edit_personal_details = user wants to change personal/account details.
exchange_charge = user asks about fees for currency exchange.
exchange_rate = user asks how exchange rates are calculated or sourced.
exchange_via_app = user wants to exchange currency using the app.
extra_charge_on_statement = user sees an unexplained extra charge on their statement.
failed_transfer = transfer attempt failed (not pending or declined).
fiat_currency_support = user asks about supported fiat currencies.
get_disposable_virtual_card = user wants to create or obtain a disposable virtual card.
get_physical_card = user asks about getting a physical card or PIN availability.
getting_spare_card = user asks about ordering or costs for an extra/spare card.
getting_virtual_card = user wants to obtain a virtual card.
lost_or_stolen_card = user reports a lost or stolen card and needs replacement.
lost_or_stolen_phone = user reports a lost or stolen phone affecting app usage.
order_physical_card = user wants to order a new physical card.
passcode_forgotten = user forgot their app passcode.
pending_card_payment = card payment is pending.
pending_cash_withdrawal = cash withdrawal is pending.
pending_top_up = top‑up is pending.
pending_transfer = transfer is pending.
pin_blocked = PIN attempts exceeded and PIN is blocked.
receiving_money = user asks about receiving money (e.g., payroll).
request_refund = user asks to request a refund for a purchase.
reverted_card_payment? = card payment was reverted/charged back.
terminate_account = user wants to close/terminate their account.
top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge = user asks about fees for topping up via bank transfer.
top_up_by_card_charge = user asks about fees for topping up via card.
top_up_by_cash_or_cheque = user asks about topping up with cash or cheque.
top_up_failed = top‑up attempt failed.
top_up_limits = user asks about limits for top‑ups.
top_up_reverted = top‑up was reverted or cancelled.
topping_up_by_card = user asks who can top‑up their account with a card.
transaction_charged_twice = user reports a duplicate charge.
transfer_fee_charged = user sees a fee on a transfer.
transfer_into_account = user wants to move money from another bank into their account.
transfer_not_received_by_recipient = recipient hasn't received the transfer.
transfer_timing = user asks how long transfers take.
unable_to_verify_identity = identity verification process fails.
verify_my_identity = user asks which documents are accepted for verification.
verify_source_of_funds = user asks about source‑of‑funds verification.
verify_top_up = user asks how to verify a top‑up (e.g., code).
virtual_card_not_working = user reports virtual card not working.
visa_or_mastercard = user chooses between Visa and Mastercard.
why_verify_identity = user asks why verification is required.
wrong_amount_of_cash_received = ATM dispensed an incorrect cash amount.
wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal = cash withdrawal had a wrong exchange rate.

Give back **only** the intent label.
